exposure: single intramuscular MTX injection combined with subsequent uterine curettage
uterine artery chemoembolization combined with intra-arterial MTX infusion
outcome: estimated blood loss during uterine curettage
cohort: 26 cervical pregnancy patients treated at Renji hospital between January 2000 and December 2012
finding: Uterine artery chemoembolization combined with intra-arterial MTX infusion is an efficient conservative treatment for cervical pregnancy.
